**Author** — Citadel Securities  ·  *Research note*

## Why it's here
The live-market read. Citadel describes AI as rationed by physical inputs — compute, power,
cooling — bifurcating into a frontier only deep balance sheets can afford and a cheap
"good-enough" tier for everyone else. Strip the AI vocabulary and it's the concentrated,
capital-hungry early phase of general-purpose-technology diffusion — David's dynamo in 1900.
It's the spark behind the *Tokenomics as GPT Diffusion* thesis.

::: {.pull-source}
Four mechanisms, abstracted from the AI specifics: a GPT bound by physical inputs; price
rationing into a bifurcated market; falling unit costs unlocking *more* usage (Jevons); and
durable gains only where the technology *complements* labor rather than replacing it.

[— Citadel Securities, 2026]{.attribution}
